# UmarJaum

> UmarJaum is the public identity of Muhammad Umar Jabbar — a physicist from Pakistan, software developer and SEO engineer. He is the founder, CEO and developer of the PublishRank WordPress SEO Plugin.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://umarjaum.vercel.app/): Founder-led overview and publishing systems.
- [About](https://umarjaum.vercel.app/about): Identity, physics background, mission and principles.
- [PublishRank](https://umarjaum.vercel.app/publishrank): The flagship free, open-source WordPress SEO plugin.
- [Work](https://umarjaum.vercel.app/work): Selected product and workflow evidence.
- [FAQ](https://umarjaum.vercel.app/faq): Direct answers about the founder and product.
- [Contact](https://umarjaum.vercel.app/contact): Email, social profiles and collaboration context.
